target_companies.name: Composites One
target_companies.notes: Target company - largest composites distributor in North America. Distributes fiberglass, carbon fiber, resins, core materials, and process supplies.

competitors.name: Hexcel
competitors.notes: Carbon fiber, prepreg, honeycomb. Supplier to C1 AND sells direct to OEMs. ~$1.8B revenue.

competitors.name: Toray Composite Materials America
competitors.notes: World's largest carbon fiber producer. Japanese parent, major US presence. Supplier AND direct competitor.

competitors.name: Solvay
competitors.notes: Advanced composites, specialty resins, adhesives. Acquired Cytec in 2015. Supplier AND direct competitor.

competitors.name: Huntsman
competitors.notes: Epoxy resins, polyurethanes, adhesives. Key upstream supplier also going direct. ~$6B revenue.

competitors.name: Owens Corning
competitors.notes: World's largest fiberglass producer. Major C1 supplier AND competes direct to large OEMs. ~$10B revenue.

competitors.name: Gurit
competitors.notes: Swiss composite materials, tooling, engineering. Wind energy and marine focus. Direct to OEM.

competitors.name: Teijin
competitors.notes: Japanese carbon fiber (Toho Tenax brand), thermoplastic composites. Growing US automotive presence.

competitors.name: Mitsubishi Chemical
competitors.notes: Carbon fiber (via Mitsubishi Rayon), MMA, composites. Japanese parent, large US manufacturing.

competitors.name: SGL Carbon
competitors.notes: German carbon fiber, graphite materials. Industrial composites, automotive. JV with BMW.

competitors.name: Jushi Group
competitors.notes: Chinese fiberglass giant. Massive US import volumes — very rich ImportYeti data. Direct price competitor.
